games.name: Vampire Hunters 3
games.desc:
Balance patch v1.2r, 11/08/26!

Rumours of a dark uprising echo through the lands that an evil power is awakening from its slumber. There is a vampire disguised among you, slowly draining victims of their power to continue the eternal night. Join the vampire-fighting forces to eliminate all evil before light and day is merely a wistful memory.

Vampire Hunters is a murder-mystery game series where one vampire hidden amongst the survivors desires to kill all humans before night ends. The hunters are tasked with eliminating the vampires to save the survivors, but it's no easy task! Vampires are powerful humanoids, possessing strength, speed and powers beyond anything mortal... Keep your wits about you, stay prepared and work as a team to overcome this dark force of nature.

Thumbnails by w4dfu & Mozzhii

games.name: [UPDATE!] Madness: Project Nevada Remastered
games.desc:
Project Nevada Remastered is a difficult PVP game, it is expected to constantly die.

Use codes: MiniUpdateRelease!, 3MIL!, SRRYFORDELAY! FOR INGAME REWARDS

The year is 2008. The sun is pale as always, the rents due, weapons are cheap, but most of all; today's garbage day, and you've got a lot of trash to take out.

Project Nevada Remastered is an open-ended game set in the Madness Combat universe about doing whatever you want, and how you please. Go around doing contracts for cash, be a general nuisance for nothing but kicks, be a janitor if you so desire. Become a respected SNPD officer you've always wanted to become or be the vigilante protagonist your ego always told you that you were.

CONTROLS:
-CTRL = Run
-F = Block
-R = Heavy attack
-Q = Dash

 
Make sure to join our communication server in order to not miss out on potential updates and keep track of Project Nevada's news!
